title: Account menu › Getting started: a progress ring and n/N count that follow the rail's rule, and the row leaves when every step is done or the account hid it
steps: S1: run the tracy-onboard menu-row tests (node:test, jsdom page, fake /api/onboarding and /api/seat-plan/status doors).
S2: the end-to-end form is S6 (web) and S7 (desktop) of tasks/evidence/ai-accounts-unify/stand/REPORT.md.
expect: Web, no AI account: 2/3 (sign-in and appearance always done); desktop, no account, notifications off: 2/4.
A connect published to the page copy moves the count to 3/4 without a reload; a disconnected row does not count; notifications turned on move it too.
Every step done: no row. Hidden from the account menu: no row, whatever the count. Operator switch off: no row.
No answer about the flags (no door): the row shows with the count it knows. The row's ring has stroke-dashoffset = C·(1−done/total).

tests: the web with no AI account: 2/3 — sign-in and appearance are always done
the desktop app with no AI account and notifications off: 2/4
a connect published to the page copy moves the count to 3/4 without a reload; a disconnected row does not count
every step done: no row (web, an account connected)
hidden from the account menu: no row, whatever the count
the operator switched Getting started off: no row
through apply(): the real page copy — publishStatus from a connect moves the web row from 2/3 to gone

fence: the count comes from the same stepsDone rule as the screen's rail, so the menu never disagrees with the screen
